mapper.insert: insert into sys_bookshelf_record (user_id, work_id, add_source, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at) select #{userId}, #{workId}, #{addSource}, 0, now(), now() from dual where not exists ( select 1 from sys_bookshelf_record r where r.user_id = #{userId} and r.work_id = #{workId} )
mapper.select: select w.work_id, w.title, w.cover, w.author_id, w.genre_id, w.work_type, w.upload_type, w.length_type, w.summary, w.price, w.trade_type, w.trade_enabled, w.word_count, w.episode_count, w.duration, w.is_free, w.preview_enabled, w.preview_episodes, w.status, w.is_copyrighted, w.quality_level, w.view_count, w.favorite_count, w.sale_count, w.rating, w.create_time, u.nick_name as author_name, c.category_name as genre_name, r.last_read_chapter_id, ch.chapter_no as last_read_chapter_no, r.last_read_at from sys_bookshelf_record r inner join sys_work w on w.work_id = r.work_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = w.author_id left join sys_category c on c.category_id = w.genre_id left join sys_work_chapter ch on ch.chapter_id = r.last_read_chapter_id where r.user_id = #{userId} and w.is_deleted = 0 and w.status = 'on_shelf' order by r.created_at desc, r.id desc
